name: 4-Deck Phase Strip
author: hleawilliams-commits
summary: Classic-size phase meter restored, with 3-1-2-4 lane order.
description: Restores the larger 0.1.1 meter (838 by 47 px), centered marker and saved Top/Band/Low positions, retaining lanes 3, 1, 2, 4. Top spans y46-92 and may overlap the waveform band; Band and Low can overlap other native content. The marker is independent of native left/center playhead settings. Mod Menu: on/off, 4 DECK only or all layouts, and position. Ticks show beats, not phrases. SDK services only; input-transparent display, no hooks or audio/control changes. Physical testing of this correction is pending.
